attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Faithful Assistant
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 3 of this character. It gains 1 |!power|. A character may be affected by this superpower once per Round.

superPowers.name: The Vishanti‘s Blessing
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character or an allied character within |!range| 3 of this character removes up to 2 |!damage| or one special condition. A character may be affected by this superpower only once per Round.

superPowers.name: Servant to the Sorcerer Supreme
superPowers.body: While within |!range| 3 of an allied |*Stephen Vincent Strange|, this character adds 1 die to its defense rolls.
